run_upload_gmock: run upload_gmock.py to upload a Google Mock patch for review with the googlemock group cc'd
run_upload_gmock_with_cc: run upload_gmock.py with custom --cc flags to add additional reviewers to the patch upload
review_main_function: review the main function that wraps upload.py and automatically adds the Google Mock group to cc
refactor_main_function: refactor the main function to support additional cc recipients beyond the Google Mock group
summarize_upload_gmock: summarize the upload_gmock.py script that passes command line flags to upload.py with a default cc address
